City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 11, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Statement from Congressman Levin read on the floor of Congress in honor of Former Council Member Jody Hubbard
4B.
Presentation of the Senior Citizen of the Year and Lifetime Achievement Award Winners
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the June 16, 2021, Regular Meeting, June 23, 2021, Special Meeting, and the June 23, 2021, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-08-11 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Sanderson
Approve the Warrants.
2021-08-11 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2021-04, regulating Cannabis activity in the City of Encinitas consistent with the voter-approved Ordinance No. 2020-18 (Measure H). Contact Person: Associate Planner Jedynak
Adopt Ordinance No. 2021-04 titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Titles 9 and 30 of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, Encinitas Ranch, and Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plans; and the Local Coastal Plan Relating to Cannabis Activity." (Attachment 1 of the agenda report)
2021-08-11 Item 08C Cannabis Ordinance Adoption
8D.
Approval of plans and specifications and authorization to advertise the Trail 95 (CP00F) Project. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Kirk
1) Approve the plans and specifications for the Trail 95 (CP00F) project; 2) Authorize the advertisement for construction bids of the Trail 95 (CP00F) project; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-79 entitled, "Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Approving the Design and Plans for Construction of the Trail 95 (CP00F) project, pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6." (Attachment 1 of the agenda report)
2021-08-11 Item 08D Approve Plans and Authorization to bid Trail 95
8E.
Designation of a voting delegate for the League of California Cities (LCC) Annual Conference, September 22-24, 2021. Contact Person: Executive Assistant Clisby
City Council adopts Resolution 2021-75 designating Council Member Lyndes to represent the City of Encinitas as a voting delegate at the LCC Annual Conference to be held September 22-24, 2021 in Sacramento, California.
2021-08-11 Item 08E LCC Voting Delegate
8F.
Appointment to the Environmental Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 1, 2023. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The City Council approve the Mayor’s recommendation to appoint Carol Parker to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Environmental Commission with a term ending March 1, 2023.
2021-08-11 Item 08F Environmental Commission Unscheduled Vacancy - Redacted
8G.
Contract Amendment to the As-Needed Contract with Kleinfelder, Inc. for additional Construction Management Services. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Authorize the City Manager or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute Contract Amendment 2 in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, with Kleinfelder, Inc., in the amount of $125,000 for as-needed construction management services to various projects, for a total as-needed contract not-to-exceed amount of $422,015.
2021-08-11 Item 08G Amendment #2 to Kleinfelder Contract
8H.
Acceptance of the Olympus Park Project (CP14A). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
1) Authorize the filing of the Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the subject project; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion; and 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-83 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report), entitled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Accepting the Olympus Park Project" accepting the public improvements for the Olympus Park Project as complete to the satisfaction of the City.
2021-08-11 Item 08H Olympus Park NOC
8I.
Authorization to procure Dell computer hardware. Contact Person: Interim IT Operations Supervisor O'Connor
1) Authorize the procurement of Dell computer hardware in an amount of $105,913 in FY 2021-22 using the NASPO ValuePoint (MNWNC-108) (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) and the California Participating Addendum No 7-15-70-34-003 contract pricing (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); and 2) Authorize participation in the NASPO Valuepoint (MNWNC-108) (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) and the California Participating Addendum No 7-15-70-34-003 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report) in a total amount not to exceed $477,285 for the term April 1, 2017 to July 31, 2022.
2021-08-11 Item 08I Dell Equipment Procurement
8J.
Adopting Resolution 2021-85 which rescinds Resolution 2021-40 and acknowledges and outlines the specific use of Proposition 64 Grant Funds. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Adopt Resolution 2021-85 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) which rescinds Resolution 2021-40 and acknowledging and outlining the specific use of Proposition 64 Grant Funds (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-08-11 Item 08J Adopting Res 2021-85 and Rescinding Res 2021-40 Prop 64 Grant Funds
8K.
Acceptance of the FY 19-20 Annual Pavement Rehabilitation, Overlay and Slurry Project (CS20A). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
1) Authorize the filing of the Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the subject project; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion; and 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-81 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report), entitled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Accepting the FY 19-20 Annual Pavement Rehabilitation, Overlay and Slurry Project" accepting the public improvements for the Annual Pavement Rehabilitation, Overlay and Slurry Project as complete to the satisfaction of the City.
2021-08-11 Item 08K FY19-20 Annual Paving Rehab NOC
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Council to hear from applicants and make one appointment to the Planning Commission-Leucadia Representative to fill an unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 1, 2023. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Hear each applicant’s qualifications and interest in serving on the Planning Commission-Leucadia Representative; 2) Discuss as needed; and 3) Make one appointment to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Planning Commission-Leucadia Representative with a term ending March 1, 2023.
2021-08-11 Item 10A Planning Commission Interviews-Appointment - Redacted
10B.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2021-02, which amends Chapter 30.41 Affordable Housing of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan. The Ordinance amends the inclusionary housing regulation to increase the inclusionary housing percentage requirements to better address the need for affordable units for all residential development; adoption of Resolution 2021-77 establishing an in-lieu fee as an alternative method of compliance, and adoption of Resolution 2021-78 establishing a new affordable housing impact fee for residential care facilities. Contact Person: Planning Manager Gates
1) Adopt Ordinance No. 2021-02 titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Chapter 30.41 Affordable Housing of the Encinitas Municipal Code, which proposes changes to the City's Inclusionary Housing Regulations including In-Lieu Fee and New Affordable Housing Impact Fee Requirement" (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-77 titled "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Establishing the Amount of Fees Payable In-Lieu of Providing Affordable Housing Units as Allowed by Chapter 30.41 of the City's Zoning Ordinance (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-78 titled "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Establishing the Affordable Housing Impact Fee for Residential Care Facilities, General, as Allowed by Chapter 30.41 of the City's Zoning Ordinance" (Attachment 3 of the agenda report).
2021-08-11 Item 10B Inclusionary Housing Ordinance Adoption
10C.
Public Hearing and Consideration of Adopting Resolutions Authorizing Adjustments to the Cost of Services Schedule (User Fees) to Building; Planning; Engineering; Fire Prevention; and Marine Safety Services Fees and the Schedule of Fully Burdened Hourly Rates for Services Provided to the General Public and Other Governmental Agencies for Fiscal Year 2021-22; and Establishing the Pass-Through of Actual Credit Card and Debit Card Transaction Processing Fees. Contact Person: Finance Analyst Huang
1) Adopt Resolution 2021-52 amending Building Services processing fees, effective October 1, 2021 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); 2) Adopt Resolution 2021-53 amending Planning Services development processing fees, effective October 1, 2021 (Attachment 3 of the agenda report); 3) Adopt Resolution 2021-54 amending Engineering development processing fees, effective October 1, 2021 (Attachment 4 of the agenda report); 4) Adopt Resolution 2021-55 amending Fire Prevention development processing fees, effective October 1, 2021 (Attachment 5 of the agenda report); 5) Adopt Resolution 2021-56 amending Marine Safety Services processing fees, effective October 1, 2021 (Attachment 6 of the agenda report); 6) Adopt Resolution 2021-58 amending the schedule of fully burdened hourly rates for services provided to the general public and other governmental agencies, effective October 1, 2021 (Attachment 7 of the agenda report); and 7) Adopt Resolution 2021-65 establishing the pass-through of actual credit card and debit card charges transaction processing fees, effective October 1, 2021 (Attachment 8 of the agenda report).
2021-08-11 Item 10C Fee Study Adjustments
The following Public Hearings (Items 10D and 10E) have been continued to the August 18, 2021 City Council Meeting, which begins at 6:00 p.m. (date certain).
10D.
Public Hearing Introduction of City Council Ordinances No. 2021-10, No. 2021-11, and No. 2021-12, which proposes amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan to implement Program 3A of the 5th Cycle Housing Element 2013-2021. The proposed amendments are to establish parking standards appropriate for different kinds of housing related development including transit-oriented and inclusionary affordable units, and tandem parking. Contact Person: Planning Manager Gates
This Public Hearing has been continued to the August 18, 2021 City Council Meeting, which begins at 6:00 p.m. (date certain). It only appears on this agenda because it was legally noticed.
10E.
Public Hearing and introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2021-13 which proposes Municipal Code amendments to implement the measures in the City's Climate Action Plan related to commercial building energy efficiency, renewable energy, and building decarbonization. Contact Person: Sustainability Manager Najera
This Public Hearing has been continued to the August 18, 2021 City Council Meeting, which begins at 6:00 p.m. (date certain). It only appears on this agenda because it was legally noticed.
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council initiated item from Councilmember Lyndes and Councilmember Hinze regarding establishment of a Native Plant Landscape Policy or Ordinance.
2021-08-11 Item 12A Council Initiated Item - Native Plant Landscape Policy

Council initiated item from Councilmember Lyndes regarding the implementation of Proposition 12 as soon as possible by only selling eggs, pork, and veal from cage-free facilities.
2021-08-11 Item 12B Council Initiated Item - Prop 12 Implementation

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON AUGUST 18, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
